sections.label: Reading
rules: 38 answers in 45 minutes, in the same five parts as the real test.
Each question shows its text above it. Tap "Hide text" to make room, and tap a gap in the text to jump to it.

sections.label: Thinking
rules: 40 questions in 40 minutes, like the real test: about one minute each.
Questions mix arguments (strengthen, weaken, whose reasoning is correct) with puzzles: order, time, numbers, codes and shapes.
If a puzzle is taking too long, flag it, guess, and come back at the end.

tests.label: Test 1
tests.title: Thinking Skills – Practice Test 1
tests.note: Arguments, logic puzzles and 9 picture questions

sections.label: Writing
rules: One task in 30 minutes, typed, like the real test. Planning time is part of the 30 minutes.
Read the task twice: write in the form it asks for (story, report, letter, diary…). Writing that misses the task is marked lower.
Start with a title, use paragraphs, and leave 3–5 minutes to re-read and fix spelling and punctuation.
When you finish, copy your writing to Claude for a mark and feedback.
